result.summary: Round 2, lens execution: wrote runs/WF06-20260925-01/crossreview-execution.json (sai.idea-crossreview/1). It covers all 16 scores of the market and owner_fit lenses once each; their_score values were copied from round 1. 14 agree, each note saying what was checked against the cleaned copies. 2 disagree, each with verbatim quotes. (1) market/02-sai/competition_gap: 4 -> 3. The gap rests only on the idea's own claim with no documented competitor search, unlike 03/04, which have a dated market check. The product is assembled from a rented try-on API plus simple size rules, so the entry barrier is low. (2) owner_fit/02-sai/no_selling_self: 5 -> 4. The no-code test sells a paid pilot of a product that does not exist yet, on trust in an unknown person, and the pilot needs manual per-item measurements from each shop. 01 lost a point for the same kind of manual first phase. Self-check: `npm run --silent validate -- ../runs/WF06-20260925-01 --stage crossreviews` printed `E_JSON crossreview-market.json: file is missing or unreadable` and `E_JSON crossreview-owner_fit.json: file is missing or unreadable` (exit 1). These are only the other analysts' files that do not exist yet; nothing was reported for crossreview-execution.json. The full stage check waits for ORCH. Extra local check (node, whitespace-normalised substring match): 16 items, 16 unique, their_score matches round 1, all quotes found. Problems: 0.
